name: Add Values to an Empty List (Case 1)
description: Construct a program that creates a list of first ten positive odd numbers.
code:
#Step 1: Create an empty list
lst = []
#Step 2: Add the odd numbers to the list one by one
for i in range(10):
    lst.append( 2 * i + 1 ) 
#Step 3: Print the list
print(lst)

comments.content: We need to create a list of the odd numbers. Therefore, we initialize the list referred by variable lst to an empty list and will later use the function append to add odd numbers to it.

We use a for loop to iterate over the list indexes and set an odd value to each index. We need the list indexes to have a length of 10 and start at 0 with every integer number up to but not including 10. We get this sequence by calling the range(10) function.
Note that the length of the list is 10 because we want to store 10 values in this list. Also, note that all statements inside the loop need to be indented with respect to the loop header.
We want to add an odd value to each index. To do this, in each iteration, we call the function append(2*i+1) to add an odd number to the end of the list. Note that 2*i+1 is always an odd number.
We can see the content of the list by calling the print function and passing the list to that. This statement will print the list.
